## `Core/Fx/CameraShot.h`

- `struct CameraShot` — Cinematic camera shot: the field moves to 'focus' (a canvas point), zooms by 'zoom', and rotates by 'rotation' radians.
- `CameraShot`: `Float2 focus { }`
- `CameraShot`: `float zoom = 1.0f`

- `CameraShot`: `float weight = 0.0f`
- `CameraShot`: `bool keepInArena = true` — true: the visible area stays inside the arena when zoomed in (focus is pulled inward); false: focus may move outside the arena to fully frame an object at its edge.
- `struct CameraFraming` — Framing: intersects 'safeArea' (e.g. between cinematic bars) with 'viewport', inset by 'padding' from the edges; zoom stays in [minZoom, maxZoom].
- `CameraFraming`: `FloatRect viewport`
- `CameraFraming`: `FloatRect safeArea`
- `CameraFraming`: `float padding = 0.0f`

- `[[nodiscard]] CameraShot FrameCameraShot(const FloatRect& bounds, const CameraFraming& framing)` — Shot centering 'bounds' in the safe area (weight 1); empty 'bounds' returns an inactive shot.
- `[[nodiscard]] CameraShot BlendShots(const CameraShot& from, const CameraShot& to, float t)` — Blends focus, zoom, rotation and weight between two shots by 't' (0..1).
- `[[nodiscard]] CameraView ShotCamera(const CameraShot& shot, const FloatRect& viewport, const FloatRect& arena)` — Base cinematic camera; camera effects (CameraEffects2D) are applied on top.

## `Core/Fx/SpeedLines.h`

- `struct SpeedLineStyle`
- `SpeedLineStyle`: `int count = 0`
- `SpeedLineStyle`: `float rate = 0.0f`
- `SpeedLineStyle`: `FloatRange innerRadius` — fraction of half-diagonal
- `SpeedLineStyle`: `FloatRange width` — canvas units
- `SpeedLineStyle`: `float opacity = 1.0f`
- `SpeedLineStyle`: `float whiten = 0.0f`
- `SpeedLineStyle`: `float minIntensity = 0.0f`
- `void DrawSpeedLines(Painter& paint, const FloatRect& bounds, float intensity, Color4 color, float timeSeconds, const SpeedLineStyle& style)` — Lines rushing in from the edges of 'bounds' (clipped to it).

## `Core/Fx/TimeScale.h`

- `class TimeScale` — Game time flow: hitstop (brief freeze) and slow motion.
- `TimeScale`: `void Hitstop(float seconds)`
- `TimeScale`: `void SlowMo(float seconds, float startScale, float endScale = 1.0f)` — Transitions from startScale to endScale over 'seconds' real seconds, then returns to normal.
- `TimeScale`: `void Clear()`
- `TimeScale`: `[[nodiscard]] float Advance(float realSeconds)` — Converts real duration to game duration; 0 during hitstop.

## `Core/Fx/TransitionClock.h`

- `class TransitionClock`
- `TransitionClock`: `TransitionClock(float closeSeconds, float holdSeconds, float openSeconds)`
- `TransitionClock`: `void Start()`
- `TransitionClock`: `[[nodiscard]] bool Update(float deltaSeconds)`
- `TransitionClock`: `[[nodiscard]] bool Active() const`
- `TransitionClock`: `[[nodiscard]] float Cover(bool& opening) const`
